presentation.name: Find out why a Power BI report is slow before rewriting it
presentation.summary: Establishes which of three problems is slow — refresh, an interaction's query, or rendering — and requires a measurement before anything is rewritten.
benefits: Separates refresh, an interaction's query, and rendering, which rarely share a cause
Treats iterator measures, bidirectional relationships, visual count, and DirectQuery as hypotheses until a timing says where the time went
Reads a Desktop recording as the time of one interaction, which does not split engine time, formula time, and warehouse time
Says what a server trace's parts mean and what they do not prove
Hands a DirectQuery warehouse query to the warehouse's own diagnosis, and does not rewrite a measure here
